read: The economy looks firm but inflation is rising. October payrolls added 165,000 jobs and unemployment slipped to 4.1%, while September CPI reached 3.7% year over year. The Fed raised rates in September and traders see a December hike as likely. October CPI is due today, and the AI selloff adds volatility.
